name: China-friendly Local and Enterprise Identity Entry
scenario: Choose local access or team sign-in, confirm identity and tenant, recover failures, and sign out.

qrContract.reason: The prototype must not present a fake or nonfunctional QR. Production renders only a live server-issued challenge.

visualQaTasks: Confirm local and team choices are visually separate.
Confirm no QR image, SVG, canvas, or scannable artifact exists.
Confirm waiting state shows origin, computer, expiry, and comparison code.
Confirm expiry, rejection, recovery, and logout each offer one clear next action.
Confirm tenant selection names only verified teams and requires explicit confirmation.
Confirm mobile content has no horizontal overflow or obscured primary action.
